title: Status line updates never reach a computer installed before version numbers
story: I installed orion's status line before orion had version numbers. After later updates my status line never got the new features, and asking for a merge said there was nothing to merge. Now the next session offers me the new status line, and taking it keeps any edits I made.

checks.criterion: A computer whose status line stamp holds an old commit time is offered the newer status line and can merge it.
checks.steps: Set HOME to a sandbox folder. Run 'orion.sh init --project <tmp> --statusline --update-mode off'. Set line 5 of <tmp>/.claude/orion/VERSION one higher. Append '# newer line' to <tmp>/.claude/orion/statusline/statusline.sh. Set line 1 of $HOME/.claude/statusline/.orion-baseline to 1792417094. Run 'bash <tmp>/.claude/orion/orion.sh check --project <tmp> --force', then 'bash <tmp>/.claude/orion/orion.sh statusline merge --project <tmp>'.
checks.expected: check prints one JSON line offering the status line; merge says "orion's newest taken"; $HOME/.claude/statusline/statusline.sh ends with '# newer line' and line 1 of the stamp is the new version number.
